Bridge.ModListenFailed: Could not open port {0} for game mods.
Bridge.ModPortBusy: Mod port {0} is in use, probably by another controller app. Close it and restart MadSense so mods talk to MadSense.
Bridge.ModConnected: A game mod is sending effects to the controller.
Bridge.ModeChanged: {0} mode. If your game was already open, restart it so it detects the new controller.
Bridge.SaveSpeakerFailed: Could not save the speaker level: {0}
Bridge.Waiting: Waiting for the controller · press PS
Bridge.Paused: Paused · other apps can use the controller
Bridge.ConnectedXbox: Connected as an Xbox controller · open your game
Bridge.HidingController: Hiding the physical controller to avoid duplicate input…
Bridge.ActivationFailed: Could not start the bridge. Check the log.
Bridge.CompetingApp: Another controller app is open. Close it: only one app can control the controller.
Bridge.HidHideMissing: The HidHide driver is missing. See the README for installation instructions.
Bridge.HidHideBlocked: HidHide is hiding the controller from MadSense. Add MadSense.exe to HidHide’s allowed applications.
Bridge.UsbConnected: DualSense is connected by cable and already works natively. To use Bluetooth, unplug the cable and press PS.
Bridge.PairingNeeded: Waiting for the controller · press PS. It must be paired over Bluetooth in Windows.
Bridge.StartingXbox: Controller connected over Bluetooth. Creating the virtual Xbox controller.
Bridge.StartingDualSense: Controller connected over Bluetooth. Creating the virtual DualSense.
Bridge.LinkLost: The controller is off or out of range. Press PS when you want to continue.
Bridge.InputTimedOut: No input from the controller for five seconds. Waiting for it to reconnect…
Bridge.CreationFailed: Could not create the virtual controller. Check that USBip is installed. Retrying in 10 seconds.
Bridge.HeadsetConnected: Headset connected to the controller: audio now goes through the jack.
Bridge.HeadsetDisconnected: Headset disconnected: audio returns to the controller speaker.
Bridge.HideFailed: HidHide could not hide the physical controller: the game may detect it twice.
Bridge.Hidden: Physical controller hidden: the game will only see the virtual one.
Bridge.ReadyXbox: Ready to play as an Xbox controller.
Bridge.ReadyNative: Ready to play: haptics, triggers and speaker active.
Bridge.NotRunning: The virtual bridge is not active.
Bridge.TriggerTestFailed: Virtual output did not produce a valid Bluetooth trigger effect.
Bridge.OutputTest: Virtual USB → Bluetooth output test: writes before={0}, after={1}; errors={2}. Physical feedback requires human verification.
Maintenance.AbsoluteResultPath: The result path must be absolute.
Maintenance.AlreadyRunning: MadSense is already open. Setup will not open another copy.
Maintenance.NotRunning: No other copy of MadSense is open.
Maintenance.MissingInstallPath: Missing --install-path with the absolute path to MadSense.exe.
Maintenance.InvalidInstallPath: The installation path must be absolute and end with MadSense.exe.
Maintenance.UnknownLocation: The location of an open MadSense copy could not be verified. Close it from the system tray and try again.
Maintenance.OtherSession: This MadSense installation is open in another Windows session. Close it before continuing.
Maintenance.CloseFromTray: Close this copy of MadSense from the system tray using “Exit and release controller”. Then try again.
Maintenance.WaitForExit: MadSense is still releasing the controller. Wait for it to close and try again.
Maintenance.StillRunning: The copy being modified is still open. It has not been forcibly closed and its data has not been deleted.
Maintenance.PendingRecovery: Controller recovery is pending and another copy of MadSense is open. Close that copy before continuing.
Maintenance.OpenedDuringCheck: Another copy of MadSense opened during the check. Close it and try again.
Maintenance.RecoveryFailed: Could not restore the controller state. Its recovery data has been kept. {0}
Maintenance.Ready: MadSense is ready. The controller and its recovery data have been checked.
Recovery.HidHideUnavailable: HidHide is not operational; restart Windows and try again.
Recovery.RestoreFailed: Could not restore HidHide. The recovery journal has been kept.
